BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 5, 2026, that it purchased a total of 62,268 of its ordinary shares on March 4, 2026, across various trading venues, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $113.03. These repurchased shares will be cancelled as part of CRH's ongoing share buyback program, which aims to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. Following these transactions, CRH will have 669,722,061 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,643,874 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.053% of its issued share capital. Disclaimer* 5 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 4 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 669,722,061 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.053% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
